scores.tell: Tone-on-tone stripes and a plain ledge, quiet like real cards; only the hard ledge line is a small tell.
none: object floats on a flat diagonal stripe field with no props.
Truss rig crossing the top is a big busy secondary structure. The gradient backdrop is quiet but the truss competes with the hero.
Full desert scene with mesas, clouds, scrub bushes, pebbles and rails is busier than real category-4 cards. Detail is small and scattered, and the heavy rail diagonal is a competing shape.
none: flat purple ring field, no props.
none: flat radial burst, no props.
Pink stripe wall with a cracked flagstone floor and a glowing flame under the pot. The paving is busy and the flame is an invented prop.
Moon-surface ground has many scattered rocks and craters, and a separate burst backdrop clashes with it. The ground is mid-busy, with more pebble clutter than the real cards.
Layered hedge, lawn, sky, paving and clouds are tidy and large, like the swing card. The leaf texture on the hedge adds a lot of small detail.
Sea with ripples and caustics, sand, foam, rope and lifebuoy props. Water detail is fairly busy and the lifebuoy and rope are extra props.
